name: bb-plugin-chat-dock
description: A ChatGPT page in BB: chatgpt.com shows inside the page in a window of its own that keeps you signed in; preview text you selected in a thread, copy it, or hand it to that window, where you confirm the insert into the open conversation's draft. You send the message yourself.
author: Mesteriis
